data.revised_prompt:
High-fidelity desktop web app direction comp, 1536x1024 landscape, realistic operating interface for Glacier Signal Chinese A-share evaluation screen, designed as an aircraft maintenance control-room airworthiness release certificate, NOT a poster. No airplane photo, no cockpit fantasy, no generic financial cards, no neon, no device frame, no watermark.

Overall structure: slim left/top navigation strip, a huge tail-number style stock identity area reading '贵州茅台' and '600519.SH', a left GO/NO-GO checklist panel, a central flight-release verdict module with the exact text '等待转强' and a score '71 / 100', a right payload-like risk limits module with exact text '结构止损 ¥1,198.00' and a position output area, then detailed technical modules beginning below the main verdict row. Include exact text 'Glacier Signal', '硬性过滤', '技术评分', and '查看近两年回测'.

Design language: pale aviation aluminum, navy maintenance ink, yellow inspection tag accents, restrained vermilion rejection stamp, subtle rivet/punched details used sparingly, stamped sign-off fields, crisp condensed grotesk typography with tabular numerals, highly legible, operational, repetitive-use friendly, dense but clean enterprise UI. Use palette prominently: #102B3A, #E9ECE7, #F0B323, #D64933, #6D858F. Background should feel like brushed aluminum/maintenance board. Include thin dividers, technical labels, status chips, checklist ticks, approval stamps, inspection fields, calibrated numerical readouts, and modular sections with data tables and mini technical charts.

Layout details: slim navigation with icon-like labels on the far left; top identity band with oversized stock name; left column GO/NO-GO checklist with several checked and unchecked items and a hard filter badge '硬性过滤'; center verdict panel styled like airworthiness release certificate showing '等待转强' in a stamped verdict capsule and score '71 / 100'; right column risk limits and position output including stop loss '结构止损 ¥1,198.00', target/position lines, and a subtle sign-off area; lower section starts technical modules with headings and dense analytical rows. The interface should look like a real operating screen used daily in a control room, not decorative art.

Use restrained vermilion only for rejection stamp / warning highlight, yellow for inspection tags, navy for headings and data, aluminum gray backgrounds. Condensed sans-serif Chinese/Latin UI typography, tabular numerals, precise alignment, production-ready, premium fintech-industrial hybrid interface.
